thresholds.world: abs(X)>1.4m or abs(Y)>1.4m or Z>2.2m or Z<−0.3m, or nonfinite
thresholds.temporal: a corresponding evaluated vertex moves >0.12m between adjacent 24fps frames; flags require interpretation

limits: Finite/bounds and temporal screening only; not cloth/body intersection clearance or artistic acceptance. No scene or file mutation saved.
